document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
As you lower yourself slowly down on the rope, you pass a mosaic 
of incredible brutality. Creatures covered with bubbling masses 
of boils are surrounding and devouring entities that look like 
headless stalks, which, even in their monstrousness, seem to 
scream for help. Do you panic and return to 394, try to get in 
the corridor at 388, or continue down to 398? 
(394)
